name: From Golden Combs
//: Hives and frames full of honeycomb, and the trader plushies. 2.x adds no new bee products, so these are mostly ratios: a full frame, hive top or brood pot is the empty one plus the honeycomb in it (32 on a roughly 64 item, so 1.5x); an empty brood box is 1.25x a super of the same woods; a populated one is the empty one plus a wild hive (48). Only used when nothing else values the item; the '//' lines say why each number was chosen.

defaultValues.//plushy-*: a trader plushy: like a painting (64)
defaultValues.//framerack-*: a frame rack: a log and a half of wood; normally made by its recipe
defaultValues.//langstrothstack-*: no value: the stacked-hive helper blocks aren't items you can hold

relativeValues.//: a brood box is a super of the same woods with a bit more wood (the closed super: it has the recipe, the open one only borrows its value later)
a lined frame plus the honeycomb (32) the bees filled it with
a fired hive top plus the honeycomb in it
a brood pot plus its top
an empty brood box plus the bees in it (a wild hive is 48)
